items.quote: Interested Consultants should provide information demonstrating that they have the required qualifications and relevant experience to perform the Services.

The Consultant shall have completed at least one (1) assignment in passenger railway and/or multimodal transport modeling financed by an International Financial Institution, and at least one (1) assignment in a Central Asian country.
Client references and completion certificates are required.

The Consultant shall have completed a minimum of two (2) assignments in transport sector reform and/or regulatory reform of state-owned enterprises (SOEs) in Central Asia, with at least one (1) such assignment in Uzbekistan.
Client references are required.
The Consultant shall demonstrate experience in financial and economic analysis of public services, including operational efficiency assessment.
Experience in socioeconomic impact assessment in the transport sector will be considered an advantage.
The Consultant shall demonstrate prior work experience in Central Asia's transport sector (with preference for experience in Uzbekistan)
maintain a minimum of one (1) professional staff physically based in Uzbekistan for the duration of the Assignment
Working materials shall be in Russian and/or Uzbek, final deliverables in English and Russian, with executive summaries also in Uzbek.
The Consultant is responsible for any translation costs.

Consultants shall clearly describe relevant assignments, indicating the client, country, duration, scope of services, financing source, and role of the firm, supported by verifiable client references.
Key Experts will not be evaluated at the shortlisting stage.
The shortlist will contain 5 to 8 firms.
setting forth the World Bank's policy on conflict of interest
Consultants may associate with other firms to enhance their qualifications, but should indicate clearly whether the association is in the form of a joint venture and/or a sub-consultancy.
In the case of a joint venture, all the partners in the joint venture shall be jointly and severally liable for the entire contract, if selected.
A Consultant will be selected in accordance with the Quality and Cost-Based Selection (QCBS) method
Expressions of interest must be delivered in a written form to the address below (in person, or by mail, or by e-mail) by November 2, 2026, 8 p.m. (Tashkent time).
Late expressions of interest will be rejected.
